sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore concerns persist ('iron ore roaches seeth'), but gold, rare earths, uranium, and phosphate sub-sectors show strong project momentum. Great Southern WA gold discovery, Lindian Kazakh rare earths feed, Barkly 99% magnet extraction, Infini 5000m uranium drill, Aguia 55Mt phosphate revival.
sectors.implications: Diversified resource plays (GSG.AX, LRE.AX, BKY.AX, INF.AX, AGU.AX) offer relative strength vs. iron ore majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) facing demand softness. Gold equities (NVA.AX, GSG.AX) benefit from geopolitical safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Pressure from rising rate expectations and property credit deterioration. KPMG losing contracts and Macquarie $700m audit bid signal corporate governance stress. Insurance sector under scrutiny over cash settlements short-changing policyholders.
sectors.implications: Big Four banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face NIM pressure if RBA holds rates; property-linked credit risk rising. Macquarie (MQG.AX) audit bid is a positive catalyst. Insurance (CGU.AX, WBC.AX) faces regulatory/ASIC pressure.

sectors.trend: Oil prices climb on US-Iran Hormuz strikes; Goldman Sachs issues blunt oil/economy warning. Danish wind farm entry breaks Australia's renewable drought. Oil giant retreats on clean energy, showing limits of ESG investor pressure.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) benefit from elevated oil/LNG prices. Renewable developers (SUN.AX, LEM.AX) gain from Danish wind farm entry. Geopolitical premium supports energy equities short-term.

sectors.trend: Healthcare's best week since June driven by Moderna/Merck cancer trial data. August consumer data shows strong appetite for weight-loss drugs. Brain cancer vaccine trials progressing.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SSW.AX, and biotech names benefit from positive trial sentiment. Weight-loss drug demand supports consumer health plays. Telehealth for voluntary assisted dying adds policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Severely negative: property downturn worsens, home values decline sharply, auction sentiment crumbles, investor credit crashes post-budget tax changes. Renters see some respite. Bathla developer near collapse. Star Entertainment in distress.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (VCG.AX, DGP.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure. Developers (Bathla, Star/SGH.AX) face existential risk. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) may see defensive rotation. 'Dupe' brand trend supports value retail.

sectors.trend: AI contagion risk flagged by BoE governor; Nvidia earnings segment the tech trade; Trump data centre backlash; Qantas strike vote threatens QAN.AX operations. Automation reducing immigration needs.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global AI volatility (NVDA, AMD) transmits via ^AXJO. QAN.AX faces industrial action risk. Data centre/AI infrastructure names under pressure.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces headwinds from Wall Street slide, oil-driven inflation fears, and domestic property stress. Expect 3-5% downside risk in 1-3 months. Geopolitical Hormuz premium supports energy but broad risk-off dominates. Qantas strike and Star/Bathla distress add idiosyncratic risk. Rate expectation spike pressures growth and property sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if Hormuz de-escalates and RBA pivots to cuts. Resource diversification (gold, rare earths, uranium) and healthcare innovation provide structural support. Property sector may stabilise post-credit contraction. AI productivity gains could offset some economic drag. Key risk: prolonged geopolitical tension or AI contagion event.
